title: Can Language Models Recognize Convincing Arguments?
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the ability of Large Language Models to predict an individual's stance on political propositions based on their demographic information, which included 'religious ideology' as a factor.
findings: The study found that LLMs demonstrate human-level performance in predicting users' stances on specific topics when given their demographics and basic beliefs, which included religious ideology as one of the factors. Stacking predictions from multiple LLMs could even outperform individual human (crowdworker) performance on these tasks.
